run_read_binarized_with_dict: run the script to decode a binarized dataset using a dictionary and print text to stdout
run_read_binarized_raw_tokens: run the script to print raw token IDs from a binarized file without a dictionary
run_read_binarized_lazy_impl: run the script with lazy dataset implementation to read a binarized file line by line
review_get_parser: review the get_parser function that configures argparse for --dataset-impl, --dict, and --input arguments
review_main: review the main function that loads an indexed dataset and prints decoded or raw token lines
